checks.reason: PROD-MIX-02 proven on the live sandbox: the stored parent plan put the producer (S3 bucket) before the consumer (Lambda function) that depends on it, with one approved parent operation; its parent, desired and child-set digests, each child's subplan, semantics and effect digests and all 2 stable resource addresses were identical after the proposal, before the execution worker was stopped and at the end; the worker was stopped with the producer done and the consumer waiting for its review, the review was approved while it was down (263 s from stop to healthy) and the parent resumed after the restart; both durable receipts link their child operations, bind the semantics each child ran and re-derive from their own fields; the producer receipt was unchanged across the restart and AWS held the same one producer bucket before and after

PROD-MIX-03 proven on the live AWS sandbox: the trust change touched only the ExternalId of both sandbox roles and was restored; connection.verifyAws passed. Review path: the producer (S3 bucket) finished before the consumer (Lambda function) started; the producer's newly materialized output changed the consumer's effect, so the parent workflow opened a review binding the new parent digest (previous b662af52b221, required 432207eae634) and the consumer waited until a person approved it; both receipts link their child operations; the consumer's deployed PRODUCER_BUCKET_ARN equals the producer bucket ARN by independent readback. Preauthorized path: a second parent on the same connection had its one reference precisely preauthorized (parent operation, reference, contract, both subplan digests, desired digest, value type; one use, 15 minutes) before it started; its consumer started with no review, the preauthorization's one use was spent (1 of 1) and the product no longer lists it as able to cover a use; the second consumer's PRODUCER_BUCKET_ARN equals its own producer bucket ARN by independent readback. Approvals by an automated test approver through the browser path. A second use of the same grant is refused by the reservation (uses < max_uses), shown here as the grant no longer listed active, not by attempting a second materialization
